arguments.command:
tmpfile=$(mktemp /tmp/root-crontab.XXXXXX.txt)
crontab -l > "$tmpfile" 2>/tmp/root-crontab.err || status=$?
if [ "${status:-0}" -ne 0 ]; then
  if grep -qi 'no crontab' /tmp/root-crontab.err; then
    : > "$tmpfile"
    echo "No root crontab entries found. Exported empty file: $tmpfile"
  else
    cat /tmp/root-crontab.err >&2
    rm -f "$tmpfile"
    exit "${status:-1}"
  fi
else
  echo "Exported root crontab to: $tmpfile"
  echo "Entries: $(grep -cvE '^[[:space:]]*($|#)' "$tmpfile" || true)"
fi
rm -f /tmp/root-crontab.err

outfile=$(mktemp /tmp/root-crontab.XXXXXX.txt)

  /var/spool/cron/crontabs/root \

 do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    cat "$f" > "$outfile"
    found=1
    echo "Exported root crontab spool file ($f) to: $outfile"
    echo "Entries: $(grep -cvE '^[[:space:]]*($|#)' "$outfile" || true)"
    break
  fi
done
if [ "$found" -eq 0 ]; then
  : > "$outfile"
  echo "No root crontab spool file found. Exported empty file to: $outfile"
fi
